A firearm permit of the same level (I, II or III) makes guns, ammo, attachments and armor of that level restricted: legal to sell, with a markup.

The Heavy Weapons Permit also covers every level-3 item.

Level 4 (the DMR) and all substances can never be made legal.

Put it in a 3D printer with the Metal Printing and CNC modules and the listed materials. Prints the gun frame; printer quality improves the finished gun.

1) Get a 3D printer with the Metal Printing and CNC modules (Gun Dock).
2) Insert a frame chip and the materials it lists, power the printer.
3) Drag a gun part onto the printed frame: the gun is ready. Better printer modules give better guns.

No printer? Buy a ready frame and a gun part at the Gun Dock.
